english: Approve the payment on your phone
MTN Mobile Money sent a request to {phone} to pay {amount}. Enter your MoMo PIN to approve it.
kinyarwanda: MTN Mobile Money yohereje kuri {phone} icyifuzo cyo kwishyura {amount}. Andika umubare w'ibanga wa MoMo kugira ngo ucyemeze.

english: Test system: MTN approves test payments by itself within seconds, and no real money is taken.
kinyarwanda: Sisitemu y'igerageza: MTN yemeza ubwayo kwishyura kw'igerageza mu masegonda make, kandi nta mafaranga nyayo akoreshwa.

english: MTN Mobile Money has not answered yet. If you approved the payment, the bill will show as paid soon: check your bills before you pay again.
kinyarwanda: MTN Mobile Money ntirasubiza. Niba mwemeje kwishyura, fagitire iragaragara ko yishyuwe vuba: banza urebe fagitire zawe mbere yo kongera kwishyura.

english: The payment did not go through
Nothing was taken from your account. You can try again.
kinyarwanda: Nta mafaranga yavuye kuri konti yawe. Mushobora kongera kugerageza.

english: Test payment: no real money was taken.
kinyarwanda: Kwishyura kw'igerageza: nta mafaranga nyayo yakoreshejwe.
